tips.text: Race once you can afford the entry fee; a 10-gate race pays far more standing than a maxed trick chain.
Earn your first standing with trick chains on the pipe behind the Fortuna elevator building.
Pick the long races on the daily rotation, such as Grinding the Void, Meat and Greet and Lord of the Board.
Buy Inertia Dampeners at Rank 3, then Extreme Velocity, Nitro Boost and Primo Flair at Rank 5.
Race on Yareli's Merulina if you own her; it cannot fall off and has a double jump.
Wait for the trick points display to clear after landing; touching down again loses the chain.
Slow down for the last gate of a race; passing it at very high speed can skip its count and time bonus.
Leave and re-enter Fortuna before spending if your standing looks doubled after a big trick session.
Gather the Orb Vallis component materials during the same standing sessions.
Take one of the three blueprints as the free Rank 5 item; it saves 25,000 standing.
Nobody calls it hard, only tedious and daily-capped; knowing the pipe and race tricks is the whole barrier.
